Priya (Console PM): quick sync — we need a concrete list of runtime/infra fields and sampling semantics for the new Request Visibility dashboard. goal: correlate request_id -> trace/span sampling -> p50/p95 per model route. who owns what?

Omar (Runtime Eng): we can emit headers and telemetry fields. minimum: `x-request-id`, `trace_id`, `span_id`, `sampled` (0/1), `model_variant`, `route`. will need a tiny header passthrough change in the frontend proxy.

Lin (Platform): +1. Also suggest exposing `service_shard` and `batch_size` (helps explain latency variance). we should standardize metric names now.

Claire (SRE): for dashboards we need: `redwood.request.latency_ms.p50/p95`, `redwood.request.trace_sampled.count`, `redwood.request.span_count.avg`, and a rollup for `request_id.errors`. sampling flag must be available in logs to join metrics -> traces.

Devin (Eng-Platform): can we adopt a deterministic sampling rule so dashboards don't have blind spots? e.g. sample if hash(trace_id) % 100 < N_per_route. simpler for rollout.

Omar (Runtime Eng): yes — deterministic sampling is ideal. implementation sketch: `sampled = (XXH64(trace_id) % 100) < route_config.sample_rate`. prop that value into `sampled` header and telemetry envelope.

Priya (Console PM): that works. UX ask: can console show both sampled traces and estimated aggregate metrics (corrected for sampling rate)? we'll want to show estimated true p95 when only a subset is sampled.

Claire (SRE): we can emit `trace_sample_rate` per-route as a tag so dashboard math can upweight sampled values: observed_latency / sample_rate_estimate. need to be explicit about confidence bands.

Omar (Runtime Eng): practical notes: kv-cache + batching can change `span_count` dramatically. so include `batching_enabled` bool and `effective_batch_size` int in telemetry. otherwise latency attribution will be noisy.

Lin (Platform): owners: runtime emits headers/fields (Omar). infra/ingest ensures fields reach metrics pipeline (Lin/Devin). SRE will own dashboard definitions (Claire). Console PM owns UX decisions (Priya).

Devin (Eng-Platform): ingest schema proposal (example):
```
headers: { x-request-id, trace_id, span_id, sampled }
telemetry: { route, model_variant, service_shard, batch_size, effective_batch_size, batching_enabled, trace_sample_rate }
metrics: { latency_ms, span_count, error_bool }
```
we'll push a proto/avro + mapping doc.

Priya (Console PM): timeline? we need a canary dashboard in staging before next release. target: sample-rate telemetry + headers in staging by EOD Thu, dashboard skeleton Fri.

Omar (Runtime Eng): can do a small PR to passthrough headers + tag telemetry by Wed. deterministic sampling will be behind a flag.

Claire (SRE): I'll draft dashboard queries using sampled-join pattern and estimation formula. will ping @eng-sre for review.

Devin (Eng-Platform): note about privacy/compliance: do NOT log full traces for PII flows. flagged routes should have sample_rate=0 or strip payloads. add `pii_safe` tag to route config.

Priya (Console PM): great — action items: (1) Omar: header + telemetry PR; (2) Lin/Devin: ingest mapping + metric names; (3) Claire: draft dashboards; (4) Priya: console UX for sampled vs estimated. will follow up in weekly rollout meeting. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: deploy pipeline status — staging build 0.71 queued for runtime changes (owner: Omar).
